description: Traceability tests. Every number in the model must be reachable from GEOMETRY-CONTROL.md, and every source cited there must exist in SOURCE-REGISTER.md. Run with: python scripts/validate_dimensions.py

tests.title: Every source cited by a control exists in the source register
Every control graded A, B or C cites at least one source
Every placeholder control cites no source
tests.rationale: A sourced value belongs in the Tier A/B table, not the placeholder table.

tests.title: Every control reference on a part resolves to a control ID
Every open question cited by a part exists in GEOMETRY-CONTROL.md section 5
Every part declares a non-empty source_basis
Only source bases the register actually supports may be claimed
tests.rationale: Milestone 1 forbade every non-dimensional basis because nothing had been ingested. At Milestone 8 'photo' became legitimate: SRC-018 is registered, CC BY 4.0, verified, and its photographs are ingested under sources/ with licence records and checksums. The other three stay forbidden because no drawing, mesh or photogrammetry asset exists in this repository yet. The test now guards that boundary rather than enforcing a blanket ban.

tests.title: Controls whose sources are all unverified are reported as verification_pending
Every registered source that a control depends on appears in the verification queue or is verified
Every part is assigned to a system in the handoff taxonomy
Every part records review_status and last_modified_by_agent
The parts manifest was generated from the current GEOMETRY-CONTROL.md
tests.rationale: Catches a stale build after an edit to the control document.
